title: Daylight Protocol / Unbound
description: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The Night Index is published with its signatures intact. People begin auditing the systems that decide their lives. The release reaches every district at once. It breaks the old consensus and leaves difficult repairs for the survivors.

lore.title: Daylight Protocol / Unbound / Unsent message
lore.text: RHEA / public archivist: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.
